summary.text: Peter Lumaj is the Republican nominee for Secretary of the State, a Fairfield real estate investor and former immigration legal adviser. He has sought statewide office repeatedly, including two bids for U.S. Senate and a run for governor.

paragraphs.text: Lumaj was born in Albania. He worked as an immigration legal adviser and is now a real estate investor in Fairfield.
Lumaj has run unsuccessfully for statewide office four times: twice for U.S. Senate, once for governor and once for Secretary of the State.
His only appearance on a November ballot before this year was as the Republican secretary nominee in 2014.
